title: WildTrace: Evaluating Training Data Detection in Realistic Large-Scale LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.16152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although post-training significantly enhances model performance, the use of massive undisclosed data raises concerns about benchmark contamination and copyright infringement. This drives growing interest in training data detection for post-trained models. Existing evaluations for training data detection often leverage benchmarks constructed post hoc, which can introduce distribution shifts. Alternatively, controlled evaluations rely on small-scale training setups that diverge from realistic post-training settings. As a result, their reported performance may not faithfully reflect the effectiveness of detection methods in real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce \textsc{\method}, a reliable benchmark designed to evaluate detection methods in realistic, large-scale post-training settings. translated_title: WildTrace：在真实的大规模LLM后训练中评估训练数据检测
translated_abstract: 尽管后训练显著提升了模型性能，但使用大量未公开的数据引发了关于基准污染和版权侵权的担忧。这推动了人们对后训练模型训练数据检测日益增长的兴趣。现有的训练数据检测评估通常利用事后构建的基准，这可能引入分布偏移；而受控评估则依赖于与真实后训练设置相偏离的小规模训练设置。因此，它们报告的性能可能无法忠实地反映检测方法在真实场景中的有效性。为此，我们提出了WildTrace，一个旨在评估真实、大规模后训练环境中检测方法的可靠基准。WildTrace基于多阶段流水线构建，涵盖了后训练生命周期中各个阶段的模型，包括SFT、DPO和……
tldr: WildTrace是一个在涵盖SFT、DPO等多阶段的真实大规模后训练设置下评估训练数据检测方法的可靠基准，解决了现有评估中分布偏移及小规模训练设置脱离实际的问题。
en_tdlr: WildTrace is a reliable benchmark for evaluating training data detection methods in realistic, large-scale post-training settings spanning multiple stages (SFT, DPO, etc.), addressing the distribution shifts and unrealistic small-scale setups in existing evaluations.
